Active is not Costing Ready: the activation check passes while only the five essentials are modelled (readiness dimensions beyond the five are NOT evaluated by the guard)
deleting the approved PM BOM revision and expiring the batch-size reference do NOT deactivate the active SKU (explicit existing boundary; no automatic deactivation)
the SAME guard helper now reports both dependencies missing (detection source exists, evaluated on demand)
source-epoch hooks fire on both dependency writes; the (modelled) freshness read turns STALE, fail-closed, until a governed rebuild; absent build also fails closed

nothing in the model alerts anyone or rebuilds: STALE persists on repeated reads and the build count is unchanged until an explicit build call (matches the 12 Nov production recovery, which needed an owner-authorised one-off call)
with the clock past effective_to and NO row written, the activation helper (as-of = today IST) reports BATCH_SIZE_REFERENCE missing for the already-active SKU

…while NO epoch changes and the modelled freshness read still returns FRESH: write-triggered hooks cannot observe passage of time (structural property; the real fingerprint composition is NOT captured — catalog question Q5)

the helper's as-of date (today IST, 2027-01-05) differs from the governed period valuation date (2026-09-10) that LIVE_AS_OF readiness is evaluated at — the activation guard and readiness evaluate different dates
editing pack/UOM/sample on an ACTIVE SKU is allowed even though its MRP policy is now missing (already-active boundary: essentials are not re-checked on edits)
every active edit is recorded with exactly the changed columns by the verbatim change log

PROVEN PREVENTION GAP: re-parenting an ACTIVE SKU to an Active product that has NO batch size and NO route is accepted — the completeness trigger fires (UPDATE OF product_id) but returns early because the row was already active
…detection still exists: the helper now lists the product-level essentials missing for the moved SKU and the product_skus epoch hook fired
re-parenting an active SKU to an INACTIVE product IS blocked by the parent-active guard
the freshness read goes STALE after these active edits (epoch bumped by the writes)

the SKU-side triggers alone do NOT stop a product being set Inactive while an active SKU exists (leaves an active SKU under an inactive parent) — coverage rests on the product-side guard documented in WP-02 whose live definition is NOT captured
STAND-IN of the documented product-side guard: product inactivation blocked while any SKU is active; allowed after the SKU is deactivated
once the parent is Inactive, SKU reactivation is blocked by the verbatim parent guard (even though the five essentials are complete)
two overlapping approved PM BOM revisions make activation (and the pre-check) RAISE AMBIGUOUS_PM_BOM_REVISION — fail-closed, but as a raw exception rather than a listed 'missing' item
as-of uses the IST calendar day, not UTC (20:00 UTC on 14 Nov = 15 Nov IST) when it is later than the period valuation date
a LATER governed valuation date beats today's IST date (greatest rule)
once IST today passes the latest valuation date, today wins again (20:00 UTC 28 Feb = 1 Mar IST)
a direct (non-RPC) deactivation leaves NO lifecycle audit event but IS captured in the change log with actor_user_id NULL (service/SQL-editor signature)
audit rows are append-only in behaviour: later edits add rows and never rewrite earlier snapshots
every fixture object is classed LIVE-VERBATIM / REPO-VERBATIM / STAND-IN; the live-verbatim set equals the five captured functions + two triggers
